about: Ledger for every recorded sound and music bed in brand/sound/. A file not listed here must not be used. `file` is relative to brand/sound/. Allowed sources: CC0 (Kenney Interface Sounds, BigSoundBank), the Pixabay Content License and the Mixkit Free License (not items marked Restricted). Pixabay items can never be part of a sonic logo or trademark. Keep the Pixabay licence certificate (PDF) for each music bed, for YouTube Content ID claims. Synthesised sounds live in sgv/sfx.py, are owned outright and need no entry. SFX files in sfx/ and ambience/ are committed; music/ stays git-ignored (this ledger is the record).

fields.source: page URL the file came from
fields.author: creator, when the source names one
fields.licence: CC0 | Pixabay Content License | Mixkit Free License
fields.certificate: Pixabay licence certificate file or URL (music), else omit
fields.tags: mood, tempo (BPM) and use, e.g. calm corporate, 92 BPM
fields.notes: edits made, what it is for
